workflows.name: invite-and-accept
workflows.outcome: invited member accepts from the email link and lands in the workspace with member rights

_automation_identities_note: identities a CI workflow or e2e setup/fixtures/teardown signs in as or resets; interactive walks use others, and the gate refuses an evidence packet that declares one of these unowned

deployed_check._note: url gets {sha} substituted; command runs in the repo, exit 0 = green, timeout 3s. Omit deployed_check entirely if the repo has no deployment yet.
